$comment: Coldline Task 3.10 public answer contract. The TTL the student chose, five values copied from the student's own probe output (the first two reads' outcomes, the first post-update read's outcome and state, and the count of stale reads after the update), and a structured freshness window. The cache contract checks compare the TTL with config/cache.yaml and the copied values with the committed probe output as written; the protected check compares the freshness window with the answer key. There is no self-attestation field, no pass boolean, and no recording URL.
title: Coldline Task 3.10 answers
description: The chosen TTL, the probe outcomes, and the freshness window for recipient acceptance.

answers.description: The only top-level answer mapping accepted by the public verifier.

status_ttl_seconds.description: The value of status_ttl_seconds in config/cache.yaml: a whole number of seconds inside the published range.

first_read_outcome.description: The outcome the probe printed for its first read, before anything was cached.

second_read_outcome.description: The outcome the probe printed for its second read, made within the TTL.

post_update_read_outcome.description: The outcome the probe printed for the first read after it marked the worker's result as written.

post_update_read_state.description: The state that first post-update read returned.

stale_reads_after_update.description: How many reads after the mark returned any earlier state, counted from the probe output.

freshness_window.description: The staleness a recipient may accept, derived from the TTL and the probe runs together.

reads_that_may_be_stale.description: Which status reads may return a copy older than the store.

max_staleness_seconds.description: The longest a status read may lag the store, in seconds, with the TTL and the invalidation in place.

acceptable_for_recipient_acceptance.description: Whether a recipient may base an acceptance decision on the status view as it now behaves.

note.description: Why, in Elena's terms: which read the clinic was acting on, what the view now guarantees about it, and one limit of the single-host run.

outcome.description: hit (served from the cached copy) or miss (read from the store), exactly as the probe printed it.
